name: payment-unpaid-stop-noise
title: 支付待付三次停查与对账日志降噪
description: Limit automatic payment reconciliation to eight hours after creation, also stop after three confirmed post-expiry unpaid results, and reduce recoverable-error log noise with accurate summaries.
creator: codex
notes: 用户回复“开始处理”已批准合并方案；任务已 in_progress。实施代码、前向迁移及本地验证，不含生产迁移/部署，不 stage/commit/push。

mobile_performance.reason: Background reconciliation scheduling and logging only. No Android/iOS pages, public endpoints, checkout inputs or interactive API algorithms change. No mobile P95 samples are invented. Validate shared-DB load, late-payment callbacks and manual query recovery in TEST and after authorized rollout.

scope: Automatic fast/expiry payment reconciliation, unpaid-stop persistence and log severity/round summaries
integration_points: PaymentOperationEvents.ts keeps failed outcomes and ops.payment_events while explicitly selecting warn only for recoverable automatic query failures
PaymentReconciliation.ts plus reconcile/expiry scripts retain basic observed operations and one business round summary; add one unpaid-limit info event
Existing centralized Chinese presentation, safe field allowlists and PaymentAlertMonitor remain authoritative
failure_paths: Upstream timeout/network/rate limiting/business failure remains failed and does not count as unpaid; severe configuration/financial/DB failures remain errors
Counter RPC duplicate/stale/concurrent/unknown result never increments twice; failed persistence remains visible and does not claim a successful stop
Notification/side-channel failure never changes settlement; absence of later events is not recovery evidence
logging_integration.correlation: Retain existing per-round ALS trace, child spans and hashed business_key. Both automatic triggers share persistent counters; no raw order/user export in planning.
logging_integration.redaction: Allow only stable error classes, bounded counts, timings and existing correlation fields. Never emit credential-bearing GET URLs, key/sign, provider raw msg, order DTOs or payment/user PII; original unexpected errors use { err } safe projection.
logging_integration.alerting: Keep ops payment facts and existing paid-not-fulfilled/create/query P0/P1 rule calculations and recovery semantics. No global log suppression or rule disabling; existing notification policy remains in force.
verification: Extend existing payment operation/reconciliation/alert and repository tests for level plus true failed outcome, round counts, duplicate/stale RPC and no false recovery
Run lint:backend-logging and TEST structured JSON/Chinese presentation verification; record unavailable local dependencies and unexecuted live-provider checks
